request: in this step, set the layout as "Conventional", not "Four up"
summary: Switch the application to the Conventional layout when this view-adjustment step opens, instead of leaving the Four up layout.
analysis: The step left the application in whatever layout was current (Four up), so the surgeon adjusted the cross lines in single slice tiles. The fix is to switch the layout to Conventional when the step opens. Confirmed the API: vtkMRMLLayoutNode.h defines SlicerLayoutConventionalView = 2 and SlicerLayoutFourUpView = 3, and Slicer code calls it as slicer.app.layoutManager().setLayout(slicer.vtkMRMLLayoutNode.SlicerLayoutConventionalView) (JRC2013Vis.py, NeurosurgicalPlanningTutorialMarkupsSelfTest.py); the extension itself uses the same layoutManager.setLayout pattern in its own setBRPLayout().
